name: The Monday Meltdown
why: It is filled with scalding caffeine and guaranteed to shatter violently into hot chaos upon impact.

lines.intro: Freshly brewed and violently caffeinated, here comes the red menace!
lines.hit: Direct splash! That is gonna leave a third-degree stain!
lines.miss: Spilled on the carpet! What a tragic waste of premium beans!
lines.parried: Hot coffee reflected right back into your morning face!
